b479-S4-p: Once you get an answer, you can ask: “What can I do in my ordinary life to prove that I heard correctly?” If it tells you to do something, I'd only do it if it's loving and leaves you free. It should make sense to you and if it's something big or hard to undo, wait till you're calm and then check it out with what you know.
b479-S5-p: Here is some inner child love. Put your hand over your heart and your other hand on your solar plexus, and say to yourself in a loving way, “Little one, you are not alone. You don’t have to fix it. I’m here now, and the adult is here now to listen to you.” Make sure you are actually talking to your inner child, who is scared to death. If you can’t do this in a loving way today, just put your hands there and see what you feel. You don’t have to fake it!
b479-S6-p+prev:
If you feel vulnerable, if you feel tightness in your throat, if you feel sadness or fear or like you’re trying to protect something, call upon your Nurturer. If you don’t feel better, or if it continues being hostile towards you, stop trying to deal with it and return to your body and the room.

You don’t have to find out if it’s a guard immediately, and you may not be able to comfort it quickly. Is this way of responding helping you to be clearer and steadier and less hooked?
